Paani kathor se kathor patthar ko bhi kaat deta hai.
Dhiraj beette samay ka kavach hai.
Ek teekha jawab ek dimaagi javelin hai.
Mahatwakanksha bheton ke baade mein bhediya hai.
Gyan apni agyanta ki gehrai ko janana hai.
Buddhi andar ki divya aag ki chingari hai.
Buddhi zameen khojti hai, dil unhe aabaad karta hai.
Dil dimaag ke khilaf ek baaghi hai.
Ichchha antrik aankh ko andha kare.
Hansi samajhdari ka sangeet hai.
Teekha dimaag sabse moti parda faad kar dekhta hai.
Gyaani moorh ki bhi sune.
Teekhi buddhi sabse tez barbaadi se aage nikal jaati hai.
Aatma ka saamaan uske pachtave se naapa jata hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz har hawa ke sath chalta hai.
Teekhi jubaan aag ke pul banati hai.
Man apani pinjara banata hai, phir rota hai.
Moorkh mann ki baat bolta hai; gyaani ispar niyantran rakhta hai.
Tabhi bolo jab chup rahna badatar ho.
Tohfe mein mile ghode ke daant nahi ginne chahiye.
Dil wo raaz rakhta hai jo hont bata dete hain.
Jo sunte hain, ve do baar seekhte hain.
Moorh ghaas mein saundarya nahi dekhe.
Jab shabd thak jaaye, tab karma bole.
Teekha dimaag maya ke aar-paar nikal jata hai.
Dimaag patthar mein bhi raaste tarash deta hai.
Ek chalak saazish samrat ko maat de deti hai.
Vichaar aatma ki boli hai.
Jeb munh mein rakhi tez talwar hai.
Insaani bhulbhulaiya ka koi exit nahi, bas gehraai hai.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Insaani rooh andheri gufaon mein roshni dhoondti hai.
Ek chatur jawabi hamla dimaag ka dwand hai.
Chaand par mat bhoko.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Lalach ek atal pyaala hai.
Moorhta ek bhari bojh hai.
Buddhi buddhi ki muskaan hai.
Buddhi bhaari bojh ko halka kar deti hai.
Sammelan sangeet ki aatma hai.
Hum swayam ke samudra par ajnabee ki tarah chalte hain.
Satya ko kisi bhesh ki aavashyakta nahi.
Yaadein wo bachati hain jo waqt dafnaana chahta hai.
Buddhi sabse andhere ghanton mein chamakti hai.
Bhoolna insaan ka swabhaav hai; bhool mein rehna moorhta hai.
Ek chalak mazak zakhi rooh ko theek karta hai.
Pathar mat bano, paani bano.
Dimaag ankahe shabdon ke samandar ka naksha banata hai.
Shor machaati bheed mein gyan dheere se bolta hai.
